extName.description: The store title and the name in the browser's extension list. At most 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Highlight text and add notes on any web page. No sign-up, no server of ours: sync via your own Google Drive, encrypted if you like.
extDescription.description: The store summary. At most 132 characters.

lang.description: The language tag of this catalogue, set on the pages so text is shaped for it.

noNotesOnPage.message: No notes on this page yet

noNotesOnPageHint.message: Select any text on the page, then pick a color or write a note.

noNotesAnywhereHint.message: Every page you annotate is collected here.

reloadToAnnotate.message: This tab was open before Fukidashi was installed or updated. Reload it to add notes.

cannotAnnotate.message: Notes can't be added to this page

cannotAnnotateHint.message: Browsers keep extensions out of some pages, such as their own settings and the extension stores.

reviewAsk.message: Finding Fukidashi useful? A rating in the store helps others find it.

exportTitle.message: Save your notes to a file

exportBody.message: Writes every note you have, including the pages you are not looking at, to one JSON file.

importTitle.message: Read notes back from a file

importBody.message: Adds what the file holds to what is already here — nothing on this device is replaced. A note edited in two places keeps whichever version was written last, and a note deleted on either side stays deleted.

importNotJson.message: This file is not readable JSON.

importNotExport.message: This file is not a Fukidashi export, or part of it is damaged.

importNewerVersion.message: This file was written by a newer version of Fukidashi.

markdownTitle.message: Take your notes to a notes app

markdownBody.message: One Markdown file holding every note, under the page it was taken on. Notion reads plain Markdown; Obsidian gets the properties, callouts and highlights it understands. This one is written to be read — only the file above reads back in.

markdownFailed.message: Could not write the notes as Markdown.

syncIntroTitle.message: Keep your notes on every browser

syncIntroBody.message: Connect Google Drive and the notes you write here turn up in every other browser you connect, edits and deletions included. They go to a hidden folder in your own Google Drive that only Fukidashi can read — there is no server of ours in between.

driveSignedOut.message: Google needs you to sign in again before anything can sync.

driveWrongPassphrase.message: The passphrase on this browser is not the one the copy in Drive was encrypted with. Enter that one to keep syncing.

driveNeedsPassphrase.message: The copy in Drive is encrypted. Enter its passphrase to keep syncing.

driveOutdated.message: The copy in Drive was written by a newer version of Fukidashi. Update the extension to keep syncing.

syncCouldNot.message: Could not sync: {error}. Fukidashi keeps trying.

alsoDeleteCopy.message: Also delete the copy in Google Drive

encryptedBody.message: Encrypted with a passphrase; every other browser you connect needs it too. Removing it writes the copy in Drive back as it is — until a browser that still has the passphrase encrypts it again.

plainBody.message: The copy in Drive holds the notes as they are. Set a passphrase and they are encrypted before they leave this browser; every browser you connect will need it, and a forgotten one cannot be recovered.

dataCollectionRefused.message: Without that permission the notes cannot leave this device.

disconnectedDeleted.message: Disconnected. The copy in Google Drive is gone; the notes here stay.

disconnectedKept.message: Disconnected. The copy in Google Drive stays where it is, and so do the notes here.

disconnectSignInFirst.message: Sign in first to delete the copy, or disconnect without deleting it.

encryptedNow.message: Encrypted. From now on the notes leave this browser encrypted, and every other browser you connect will ask for the passphrase.

passphraseRemoved.message: Passphrase removed. The copy in Drive is stored as it is again — until a browser that still has the passphrase encrypts it back.

passphraseNotThatOne.message: That is not the passphrase the copy in Drive was encrypted with.

welcomeLead.message: Highlight what you read on any web page and leave notes in speech bubbles. They are where you left them the next time you open the page.

welcomeDemoHighlight.message: Write a word next to what you read,

welcomeDemoRest.message: and it is still there the next time you come back.

welcomeSelectBody.message: Select a few words on any web page, and a small toolbar appears next to them.

welcomeMarkTitle.message: Pick a color, or write a note

welcomeMarkBody.message: A color highlights the words. “{addNote}” opens a box for a memo.

welcomeReadBody.message: Hover a highlight to read its note in a bubble. Click it to keep the bubble open, and to edit or delete the note.

welcomeOpenTabs.message: Tabs that were already open need one reload before they take notes.

welcomePin.message: Pin Fukidashi to the toolbar from the browser's extensions menu: its button lists the notes of the page you are on, and every page you have annotated.

welcomePrivacyBody.message: They are kept in this browser, and there is no account with us to sign up for. To have them in your other browsers too, connect your own Google Drive in the settings; there is no server of ours in between.
